findings.title: `Integration.objects.get` in `GitHubInstallation.dispatch` is missing `provider="github"` filter
findings.body: In `GitHubInstallation.dispatch`, `Integration.objects.get(external_id=installation_id)` (line 478) and `Integration.objects.get(external_id=installation_id, status=ObjectStatus.ACTIVE)` (line 494) query the `Integration` table without filtering by `provider=GitHubIntegrationProvider.key` (or `provider="github"`). Because the uniqueness constraint on `Integration` is `(provider, external_id)` rather than `external_id` alone, if another integration provider happens to have an integration with the same numeric `external_id`, `Integration.objects.get(...)` will either raise `Integration.MultipleObjectsReturned` (causing an unhandled 500 error) or match the wrong provider's integration record.

findings.title: Direct indexing of `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` can raise `KeyError`
findings.body: At line 503, `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` assumes that every existing active `Integration` record (which has no `OrganizationIntegration` rows) has a `"sender"` dictionary in `metadata`. However, in `GitHubIntegrationProvider.build_integration` (lines 376-377), `metadata["sender"]` is only populated when `state.get("sender")` is truthy (e.g. when created from the installation webhook). If an `Integration` record was previously created through the normal pipeline (which does not set `sender` in state) and its `OrganizationIntegration` was later deleted, `integration.metadata` will not contain `"sender"`, causing an unhandled `KeyError` when reinstalling.

findings.title: `test_installation_not_found` fails on OAuth state mismatch instead of testing a 404 installation lookup
findings.body: In `test_installation_not_found` (lines 379-396), the test replaces the `/app/installations/{id}` mock response with a 404, then calls `self.setup_path` with `state=ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05` instead of starting from `self.init_path` with the pipeline's actual signature (`9cae5e88803f35ed7970fc131e6e65d3`). As a result, `OAuthLoginView` rejects the request at line 412 due to the `state != pipeline.signature` check and returns `"Invalid installation request."` before `GitHubInstallation` or `get_installation_info` is ever reached. The 404 response on `/app/installations/{id}` is no longer exercised by this test.
